reason: I'd happily take the free listing since it costs me nothing and they load the flyers, but I wouldn't pay anything now. 500 sign-ups in a city is a list, not an audience, and I've been burned by boosts that give me no numbers.
objection: How many people actually use this app here? 500 waitlist names isn't the same as people going out and opening it on a Friday night.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the published monthly active users pass 2,000 in my city, plus proof from another venue that the stats show real views and saves that turned into people at the door.
